description.en: Creates a detailed (Hi) model of an NPC given by ID string: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(1, _charaName, set, _npc_id, true, false, _no_base, _mem), with set "Talk" when _talk is true.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
true for the "Talk" motion set (talking model), false for "dmy".
Passed as CMND_CREATE_CHARA's noBase flag (effect not traced).
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: A detailed NPC by ID (real usage, from ev42011100.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
